description: Authored map for the admission of the people pack (research/people), applied by scripts/people-admission.ts. It records the maintainer's decisions of 2026-10-30 (review/people-pack-2026-10-29.md, questions 1–12 adopted as recommended), the adjudication of the cross-family check of the same day, the corrections that follow from the check as worded, the records held and why, and the mappings to the schema.
snapshotDescription: Dataset state before the people admission (2026-10-31): the IDs it adds and the rows it changes as they were.
scope: On 2026-10-31, by the maintainer’s decisions of 2026-10-30 and the corrections of a blind cross-family check, a machine-prepared, machine-audited candidate pack on people was admitted: dated roles and founding credits of the chief executives and chairs of Alphabet and Google, Microsoft, Meta, NVIDIA, SoftBank Group, Oracle and Alibaba from their filings and company pages, the authorship of six texts they signed, roles of twelve persons the dataset already held, and thirty authors of single dataset texts, each identified by a second page. A role with a start and no recorded end is not evidence that the role continues; a page dated by its retrieval says only what it listed then. What the signed texts state is not yet recorded. All records are seeds; none is human-reviewed.

A cross-family check of 2026-10-30 read “Effective June 16” in an archive capture of Microsoft’s 2021 proxy statement; this admission could not retrieve that text, so no effective date is recorded.
